title: White Cotton Tunic Top for Women with Red Floral Embroidered Yoke – Short Kurti for Jeans
description:
Sindoori is the deep red of sindoor – bold red blooms on crisp white.

A timeless white cotton tunic with a full yoke of red thread embroidery – branching vines and leaves around a central flower. The notched round neckline is framed with an embroidered border, and matching red borders finish the 3/4 sleeves, the hem and the side slits.

✦ The Details
• Notched round neckline with embroidered border
• Red floral thread embroidery on the yoke
• Embroidered borders on the 3/4 sleeves, hem and side slits
• Straight cut, hip length
• Easy pull-on style

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft and breathable. The red embroidery pops against white for a fresh, classic contrast.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual top size – size up for a relaxed look.

✦ How to Style It
Light blue flared jeans, clear heels and oxidised jhumkas, as in our photos; white or beige trousers for office; a red palazzo for a festive day; sunglasses for a sunny day out.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
